runAtStartupDesc: Start SuperSonicCleaner when you sign in to the computer.
portableStartupDesc: Run at startup requires the installed version of SuperSonicCleaner.
portableUpdatesDesc: Portable builds use manual updates. Close SuperSonicCleaner and replace the app files with the latest portable download. Your settings are retained.
minimizeToTrayDesc: Closing the window keeps the app running in the system tray.
showNotificationsDesc: A system notification when an operation finishes.
threatDetectionAlertsDesc: Show a system notification when suspicious network activity is detected
autoUpdateDesc: Downloads new versions in the background; they install on the restart you choose.
autoRestartDesc: Restarts the app as soon as an update is downloaded, without asking.
updateCheckIntervalDesc: How often to look for a new version in the background.
softwareUpdaterNotificationsDesc: Checks installed apps for updates in the background and shows the count in the sidebar. Manual checks stay available in Software Updater.
preferElevatedLaunchLabel: Ask for administrator rights at launch
preferElevatedLaunchDesc: When SuperSonicCleaner starts without administrator rights, it asks for elevation right away (UAC on Windows, polkit on Linux). Off by default.
windowsPackageManagerDesc: Choose which package manager to use for software updates
backupFolderDesc: SuperSonicCleaner writes registry and shell-extension backups here before each change. If you switch folders, existing backups stay where they are.
backupFolderUpdatedDesc: Existing backups remain in their previous location.
backupModeDesc: Targeted saves only the keys that change (a few KB). Full saves whole branches before each run (hundreds of MB).
protectRecycleBinDesc: Cleaning skips the Recycle Bin, so files deleted by mistake stay recoverable.
secureDeleteDesc: Overwrites files before deleting them. Cleaning takes longer.
closeBrowsersDesc: Closes open browsers to unlock their cache files.
createRestorePointDesc: Creates a Windows restore point before cleaning. Requires administrator rights.
keepDeletionLogLabel: Keep a log of deleted files
keepDeletionLogDesc: Records every deleted path, shown in the details of each cleanup in Activity. The log lives in the SuperSonicCleaner data folder and is cleared together with the history.
skipRecentFilesDesc: Does not delete files modified within this interval.
startupSettingFailedDesc: Task Scheduler may be restricted by group policy or security software.
updateChannelDescription: Get the latest improvements for your edition of SuperSonicCleaner.
upstreamCredit: Built on Kudu by Advent Development
updateRestartDescription: SuperSonicCleaner will close, install the update, and reopen. Finish any running tasks before restarting.
settingsSaveFailed: Could not save settings. The previous value has been restored.
updateCheckDescription: Check for a newer version of SuperSonicCleaner.
updateNoticeDescription: Keep SuperSonicCleaner up to date. Restart when it suits you.
forkAttribution: SuperSonicCleaner is an independent fork of Kudu, distributed under the MIT license. Original copyright © 2026 Advent Development Inc.
exclusionsHelp: Absolute paths or extensions (*.ext) that cleaning always skips.
